standard_prerequisites.name: Coefficient extraction and homogenization
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact author Lemmas61/62 credited to [43] and [45] retained.

core_obligations: Preserve full original field/low-degree divisor conditions and both circuit models.
Retain full quotient/remainder gate simulation, long-division and monic-transformation proofs.
Retain all border homogenization and epsilon-specialization continuation; do not split support or parameter variants.
difficulty_reason: The authors track quotient and every low-degree remainder coefficient at each circuit gate, using a small long-division circuit for products. A simultaneous monic variable change handles leading coefficients, and homogenization plus formal epsilon-specialization extends the construction to border complexity.

dedup.scope: Root complete identity refresh for official DOI and ECCC TR21-072 across legacy/prepared/both other lines found zero matches. Ordinary/border/univariate/constant-free forms grouped, support not split. No additional confirmed identity.
